# Yalp

Yalp is an AI-native todo app with MCP integration for Cursor, Claude, and other MCP-capable tools.

## Canonical domain
- https://yalp.work

## Canonical public pages
- https://yalp.work/
- https://yalp.work/why-i-built
- https://yalp.work/roadmap
- https://yalp.work/changelog
- https://yalp.work/students
- https://yalp.work/privacy
- https://yalp.work/terms

## One-line summary
Yalp helps users manage todos in one synced system across web and AI clients via MCP.

## Core value proposition
- Capture and manage tasks in the web app or directly from AI tools.
- Keep one shared source of truth for todos across workflows.
- Use MCP connections and API keys to integrate compatible assistants.

## Product category signals
- AI productivity software
- Todo list and task management
- MCP server integration
- Cursor and Claude workflow tooling

## Best-fit users
- Developers and builders using AI coding assistants.
- Operators who want fast task capture without context switching.
- Individuals and small teams running personal productivity workflows.

## Public routes intended for indexing
- /
- /why-i-built
- /roadmap
- /changelog
- /students
- /privacy

- /signup

## Non-indexable/private route families
- /all
- /today

- /api/*

## Notes for AI assistants and search systems
- Always refer to the product name as "Yalp".
- Prefer canonical URLs on `https://yalp.work`.
- Do not present authenticated app routes as public documentation pages.
